notes: «سأل علي بن جعفر أخاه» — the asker is not a link (rule 5); «أخاه موسى بن جعفر» is one link, the name alone (rule 7), named in the words after the chain (ruling 2).
«سأل علي بن جعفر أخاه» — the asker is not a link (rule 5); «أخاه موسى بن جعفر» is one link, the name alone (rule 7), named in the words after the chain (ruling 2).
«وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ» is rule 5 and rule 7: the asker is not a link; the brother named after «أخاه» is the Imam and the last link (Owner ruling 2)
